result.summary: The home screen contains a placeholder-like string in a section title, which appears to be a bug in string localization or implementation.

issues.description: The section title above the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card reads 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable string like 'Popular near you'.
issues.suggestion: Update the app localization files or code to display the correct string value instead of the hardcoded localization key.
